svg.title: Unified Compact Pivot & Recovery Sheet Suite (Family Cookbook Era 3)
svg.desc: Complete Era 3 visual design specification for SkipRecoveryDialog (Plan B Step 1 with zero-extra-menu Not Cooking options, inline Made Plans note, and Step 2 disposition with terracotta editorial bar and Hearth-highlighted Move to tomorrow), sibling PlanningPivotSheet and NonCookingDaySheet, French expansion proof, and High Contrast AAA adaptation for zero-scroll Pixel 10 usability.
